requirements.title: SCAN argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING and SET shall be character of the same kind, BACK shall be logical, and KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.SCAN-BACK-logical: Call SCAN with BACK=.TRUE. and BACK=.FALSE. controls and distinct expected positions; source-control mutation changes BACK to integer and records no diagnostic facet.
pending.SCAN-KIND-scalar-integer-constant: Call SCAN with a constant KIND selecting default integer and assert KIND(result)==KIND(0); source-control mutation uses a nonconstant KIND and records no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: SCAN returns leftmost, rightmost, or zero position
requirements.definition: SCAN returns the leftmost matching position by default, the rightmost matching position with BACK true, and zero for no matching character or zero-length STRING or SET.

pending.SCAN-leftmost-match: Use SCAN('FORTRAN','TR') with absent BACK and assert result 3 from a -9 sentinel; pair SCAN('FORTRAN','TR',BACK=.FALSE.) == 3 with SCAN('FORTRAN','TR',BACK=.TRUE.) == 5, and mutate BACK to .TRUE. for the leftmost case.
pending.SCAN-rightmost-match: Use SCAN('FORTRAN','TR',BACK=.TRUE.) and assert result 5 from a -9 sentinel; mutate BACK to false.
pending.SCAN-no-match-zero: Use SCAN('FORTRAN','BCD') with a companion matching call in the same fixture, assert zero for no match and nonzero for the companion, and mutate SET to include 'R'.
pending.SCAN-zero-length-zero: Use SCAN('', 'A') and SCAN('ABC','') with companion nonempty matching calls, assert zero for each zero-length case, and mutate one operand to nonempty matching text.
